generationInputs.prompt: A humorous, vintage-style poster, inspired by 1950s beauty ads, featuring a luminous pink donut and an eggplant with a syringe against a misty, dark background with glittering diamonds on the floor, all in a limited red-toned palette on a cream background. The poster features a stylized, engraved illustration in the center, rendered in a vintage red-toned palette, depicting a luminous pink donut with subtle holographic shimmer and brightly colored, almost translucent sprinkles, with its soft golden base peeking through. Next to the donut is an eggplant, also depicted as a stylized, engraved illustration, with a syringe inserted into it. Above, a large, bold headline in an arched, all-caps, mid-century serif font declares: "GET YOUR DAILY DOSE OF DELIGHT!" A tagline below reads: "OR ELSE." Sparkle and starburst icons are scattered around the headline. The background is a misty, dark expanse with brilliant, red-toned diamonds scattered across the floor, fitting the vintage aesthetic. At the bottom, a funny footer line in a retro print ad font reads: "STILL BATTERED, BUT BEAUTIFUL."
